# R2-EXCHANGE-07 — Dispute evidence packet

Assemble a **neutral, source-linked** disagreement packet from brief revision, promised criteria, and supplied outputs.

No automatic adjudication (`adjudication: null`, `winner: null`).

Reuses EXCHANGE-01 checks and EXCHANGE-03 revision fingerprint.

```sh
npm run test:r2-exchange-07
node experiments/scale-r2-20260910/exchange/07/src/cli.mjs demo
```
